# Tooltip

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:tooltip` · Kerf UI · CSS composition · Feedback

Styling for kerfjs/overlay's tooltip(): the help tag's look (loud neutral fill, on-loud 14px text, 3px radius) for a hover and focus tooltip on any element, wrapping at 40 characters, with entrance and exit motion.

## When to use

Explain a control or value on hover and keyboard focus with a styled tooltip, without hand-written tooltip CSS.

- A control or value needs a short explanation on hover and keyboard focus (a longer action description, a chart point, a truncated label): import @kerfjs/ui/overlay-tooltip.css once and call tooltip(anchor, content) from kerfjs/overlay with exitClass 'kui-tooltip-exit' and exitDuration 100.
- The explanation has structure (a bold line over a detail): pass a render function; its content inherits the tooltip's colors.

**Not when:**

- Do not add a tooltip to an icon-only control in a ToolbarControlGroup, an icon-only Button, Select, or PopupMenu; @kerfjs/ui/help-tags-register already shows its help tag.
- Do not put interactive content or the only copy of important information in a tooltip; use an AnchoredSurface or visible text.
- Do not hand-write tooltip CSS or use wa-tooltip.

**Alternatives:**

- [AnchoredSurface](./anchored-surface.md) (nearest) — Use an AnchoredSurface for interactive or persistent help that the person opens.

## Imports

- CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/overlay-tooltip.css` once.
- Declared side effects: css.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- plain text tooltip, wrapped at 40 characters
- structured content from a render function
- any placement tooltip() supports (top by default)
- native: true top-layer hosting

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** which elements get a tooltip and its content; placement, delay, and native top-layer hosting; the disposer that removes a tooltip's listeners.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: feedback). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- tooltip() positions the wrapper beside its anchor; the stylesheet caps its width at 40 characters within the viewport.

## Accessibility

- tooltip() shows on hover and on keyboard focus, gives the wrapper role tooltip, and hides on leave or blur; keep the anchor's accessible name complete without it.
- The loud neutral fill with on-loud text meets WCAG AA; forced colors draw CanvasText on Canvas, and the entrance is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion or the static-effects switch.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kerf-tooltip`, `kui-tooltip-exit`.

Classes an application may place on its own elements: `kerf-tooltip`, `kui-tooltip-exit`.

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-overlay-tooltip-z-index`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
